text: This function correctly determines whether a given Gregorian year is a leap year. It does this by first checking if the year is divisible by 4, which is a necessary condition for a year to be a leap year. If the year is not divisible by 4, it is not a leap year. If it is divisible by 4, the function then checks if it is divisible by 100. If it is, it must also be divisible by 400 to be a leap year. This ensures that the function accurately accounts for the exceptions to the general rule.
